questions.question: Do we delete the v1 unit tests or keep them? ADR-0003 (title + Decision 5), TECH-SPEC GS4 and Q1 say v1 tests/ is deleted. The owner decision says v1 tests are NOT deleted at the start and v2 is built until they pass. Which tests must pass before the first v2 merge, how do 136 tests that import ../src/ run against a new src/ layout, and where do E2E tests sit next to them?
questions.why: Blocks M0 test setup. Docs conflict with owner decision: ADR-0003:1,27-31; TECH-SPEC:38 (GS4), :404 (Q1).

questions.question: How many tools does v2 ship, 7 or 9? README §9 says 7 tools and 'No doctor, upgrade or uninstall commands'. TECH-SPEC Q3b/§3.11 and PRD §16 say ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade stay (9 tools). GP1 asserts 'tools/list (7 tools)'. Which is the source of truth for registry.ts and the GP1 golden?
questions.why: Blocks registry.ts and GP1 golden. README.md:101-103 vs TECH-SPEC:407, :349-372 and TECH-SPEC GP1 row.

questions.question: Do we ship skills or not? README §2 says 'no skills'; TECH-SPEC §3.9 ships 3 SKILL.md files (/ctx-stats, /ctx-doctor, /ctx-upgrade) in skills/; GS5 says 'The repo has no SKILL.md'; .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md also exists. Which files may exist in the repo and in the release tree?
questions.why: Blocks the GS5 lint and the release tree layout. README.md:25, TECH-SPEC:38, TECH-SPEC §3.9.

questions.question: The owner rule says the issue templates must be written fully for AI agents: an agent that reads them must follow our rules and send us the maximum debug data. ADR-0014 bug.yml is written for a human ('Run /ctx-doctor ...', a node --version input, checkboxes), caps the report at 4,096 B and drops paths, env and error text. What exact text do the templates give the agent (steps, which tools to call, what to attach, what it must never do), and which ADR-0014 limits change to reach 'maximum debug data' while secrets still never leak?
questions.why: Blocks ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml and the ctx_doctor report shape. ADR-0014:28-46, :57 vs the standing owner rule.

questions.question: The owner decided 'no npm for v2', but the /release skill step 2 runs 'npm ci && npm run build', and the PRD says the version comes from package.json. Does 'no npm' mean only the end user never runs npm (dev and CI may use npm and a bundler), or must the build also run without npm? Which bundler and which version source (package.json on v2, plugin.json on release) do I use?
questions.why: Blocks the build script and release.yml. .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md:9; PRD-v2.md §15.2 rule line; ADR-0011 branches table.

questions.question: What is the hook budget I must meet in CI: 'p95 <= 40 ms wall' (G26, GS6) or '<= 20 ms CPU on top of bare Node' (ADR-0008 Open, because bare Node is 45.6 ms p95)? And on Claude Code, is the PreToolUse hook always type mcp_tool (no process), and what about the other 3 Claude Code events?
questions.why: Blocks GP3 bench and hook entry design. TECH-SPEC:39 (GS6) vs ADR-0008 'Open' section.

questions.question: Which enforcement text is current? PRD §16 says 'PostToolUse caps oversized output ... deny only from the user's policy'. ADR-0008 r3 says hard deny for WebFetch, stdout curl/wget, inline HTTP and build tools, with no cap and no truncation. ADR-0016 adds rewrite (case B) and output replace (case C). I plan to follow ADR-0008 r3 + ADR-0016 and treat the PRD §16 line as stale. Is that right, and what is the output byte budget number for cases B and C?
questions.why: Blocks policy/ code. PRD-v2.md §16 Enforcement line vs ADR-0008 r3 and ADR-0016; no budget number found in ADR-0016.

questions.question: What is the minimum Node version (S-NODE is open), and which Node versions go into the CI matrix? Also, the PRD names npm packages nowhere for SQLite: is node:sqlite the only DB driver (no better-sqlite3, no bun:sqlite), and how does the server handle Bun users from v1?
questions.why: Blocks package engines, CI matrix and the degraded start in ADR-0014 §1. ADR-0002:37; TECH-SPEC §9 S-NODE, §6.6.
